title: A bridge between two shores
summary: An arched vermilion footbridge whose deck and rails follow two movable banks.
prompt: In Polynite, create an editable Japanese garden study: An arched vermilion footbridge whose deck and rails follow two movable banks. Compose existing operators as data recipes; keep relationships, materials and exposed parameters editable. Use the linked scene as a reference, invent your own variation, and preserve the current scene.
try: Compare the low cedar crossing and the high vermilion moon bridge.
Adjust arch, width and rail_height. Play shows the bridge following its two shores.
Through MCP, move pad_a or pad_b while stopped and inspect the endpoint anchors.
steps: Compose shared geometry and material operators from the recipe JSON.
Bind explicit supports or paths where needed, retaining stable IDs.
Expose parameters; verify changes, relationships and playback before saving.
settings: Open & test > Variant for presets; Adjust for recipe parameters. Scene settings > Living architecture exposes the same inputs. Support and path relationships are stored in the downloadable scene/recipe JSON.
limits: Stylised procedural study. Explicit analytic cube supports and flat named paths; no arbitrary terrain fitting or roof unions. Animation articulates cached petals; landscape changes occur at edit time.
